Overview

Richards Bay is a city in KwaZulu-Natal with a population of 57,000. A major deep-water port city on the Zululand coast, known for its coal exports and industrial development. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
